steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather and measure everything: beaten eggs, shabu beef, scallions, seasonings.

steps.label: Microwave pouch rice
steps.detail: Microwave a pouch of rice 90 sec, then spread on a plate to dry it out.

steps.label: Scramble the egg
steps.detail: Hot oiled pan; pour in beaten egg, scramble into small pieces, remove to a plate.

steps.label: Sear the shabu beef
steps.detail: Same pan, sear the thin beef quickly until just cooked, remove to the plate.

steps.label: Fry the rice
steps.detail: Add the dried rice, spread and char, then toss with seasoning until hot.

steps.label: Combine & plate
steps.detail: Return egg and beef, add scallions, toss to combine, then plate.

steps.label: Chop aromatics; rinse lentils
steps.detail: Dice onion, carrot, and celery; mince garlic. Rinse 1 cup dried lentils (no soak needed) and have broth measured.

steps.label: Sweat aromatics for the base
steps.detail: Heat oil in a pot. Sweat the diced onion, carrot, and celery 6 min, then add garlic and any spices and stir 1 min until fragrant.

steps.label: Add lentils and broth; simmer
steps.detail: Add the rinsed lentils and broth, bring to a simmer, then cook 25-30 min until the lentils are tender.

steps.label: Prep greens and garnish
steps.detail: While the soup simmers, wash and roughly chop 2 cups of greens (spinach, kale, or chard) and ready any garnish — lemon, grated cheese, or a swirl of oil.

steps.label: Wilt greens and season
steps.detail: Stir the prepped greens into the finished soup and cook 2-3 min until wilted. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.label: Ladle and garnish
steps.detail: Ladle into bowls and top with the prepared garnish.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Measure oil and seasonings; have frozen vegetables and a lemon ready.

steps.label: Heat the skillet
steps.detail: Heat a large skillet over high; add 1 tbsp oil until it smokes faintly.

steps.label: Char one side
steps.detail: Add frozen veg in a single layer; don't touch for 3 min to let one side char.

steps.label: Toss & finish cooking
steps.detail: Toss, then cook 3-4 min more until heated through and edges blistered.

steps.label: Season & serve
steps.detail: Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder and a squeeze of lemon.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Have frozen dumplings, oil, water, and a lidded non-stick skillet ready.

steps.label: Pan-fry the bottoms
steps.detail: Heat 2 tbsp oil over medium-high; place dumplings flat-side down, cook 2 min until golden.

steps.label: Add water & steam
steps.detail: Pour in 1/3 cup water, cover immediately, reduce to medium, steam until water evaporates.

steps.label: Crisp the bottoms
steps.detail: Remove lid; cook 1 more min until bottoms are extra crispy.

steps.label: Plate crispy-side up
steps.detail: Transfer to a plate with the crispy side facing up.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Pat the salmon completely dry, especially the skin; have oil and lemon ready.

steps.label: Season both sides
steps.detail: Salt and pepper both sides of the fillet.

steps.label: Render the skin
steps.detail: Place skin-side down in a cold pan, drizzle oil around it, turn heat to medium, cook 5 min pressing gently until skin is deep brown.

steps.label: Flip & finish
steps.detail: When albumin just appears at the edges, flip and cook flesh-side down 60 sec to finish.

steps.label: Squeeze lemon & serve
steps.detail: Off heat, squeeze lemon over the top and serve.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Beat eggs, prep protein, mince garlic/ginger/scallions, measure sauces, ready cold rice.

steps.label: Scramble the eggs
steps.detail: Smoking wok with 1 tbsp oil; scramble eggs into small pieces, remove to a plate.

steps.label: Cook the protein
steps.detail: Add 1 tbsp oil; cook protein through (or just heat if cooked), remove to the plate.

steps.label: Fry aromatics & veg
steps.detail: Add last tbsp oil; garlic, ginger, scallion whites 30 sec, then vegetables 2 min.

steps.label: Fry the rice
steps.detail: Add cold rice, break clumps, spread to char 30 sec then toss; repeat 3-4 min.

steps.label: Sizzle the sauce
steps.detail: Push rice aside, sizzle soy + oyster sauce in the empty pan, then toss together.

steps.label: Return egg & protein
steps.detail: Add back egg and protein with sesame oil, white pepper, scallion greens; toss 1 min, taste and adjust.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Pound chicken even, measure breadcrumbs, parmesan, flour, eggs, marinara, mozzarella.

steps.label: Preheat oven & line pan
steps.detail: Preheat oven to 425F and line a sheet pan with parchment.

steps.label: Set up dredging station
steps.detail: Three dishes: flour; beaten egg; breadcrumbs mixed with parmesan, herbs, garlic powder, salt.

steps.label: Dredge the chicken
steps.detail: Pat chicken dry; coat each piece flour, egg, then breadcrumb mix, pressing firmly.

steps.label: Bake the cutlets
steps.detail: Place on the pan, drizzle generously with oil; bake 18-20 min, flipping halfway, to 165F.

steps.label: Top with sauce & cheese
steps.detail: Top each piece with marinara and a mound of mozzarella.

steps.label: Melt the cheese
steps.detail: Return to the oven or broil 5 min until cheese is melted and bubbling.

steps.label: Garnish & serve
steps.detail: Garnish with fresh basil; serve over pasta or with a salad.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Pat steaks very dry, season with salt and pepper; smash garlic, measure oil, butter, thyme.

steps.label: Bring steaks to temp
steps.detail: Take the ostrich out 30 min early to take the chill off.

steps.label: Heat the cast iron
steps.detail: Heat a cast iron pan over high until very hot; add oil and wait for it to shimmer.

steps.label: Sear the steaks
steps.detail: Sear the steaks 2-3 min per side to develop a deep crust.

steps.label: Butter-baste & pull
steps.detail: Reduce to medium; add butter, garlic, thyme; baste 60 sec and pull at 125-130F for medium-rare.

steps.label: Rest & slice
steps.detail: Rest 5-10 min, then slice thin against the grain.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather and measure all ingredients, pat the chicken dry.

steps.label: Preheat oven to 425F
steps.detail: Heat oven to 425F so it's ready for roasting.

steps.label: Season the chicken
steps.detail: Pat dry, season generously with salt, pepper, and herbs.

steps.label: Sear skin-side down
steps.detail: Oil an oven-safe skillet over medium-high. Chicken skin-side down, press flat, sear 5-6 min until golden.

steps.label: Roast in oven
steps.detail: Flip, transfer skillet to oven. Roast 20-25 min until thigh hits 165F.

steps.label: Rest the chicken
steps.detail: Rest 10 min before cutting so the juices redistribute.

steps.label: Carve and serve
steps.detail: Cut the chicken and plate with the sides.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather and measure all ingredients, slice the vegetable.

steps.label: Pack the jar
steps.detail: Pack the vegetable into a clean jar with any flavorings (garlic, dill, peppercorns, mustard seed, chili).

steps.label: Simmer the brine
steps.detail: Combine brine ingredients in a small pot, bring to a simmer, stir until salt and sugar dissolve.

steps.label: Pour brine over veg
steps.detail: Pour the hot brine over the vegetables until covered.

steps.label: Cool on the counter
steps.detail: Cool on the counter (about 45 min).

steps.label: Refrigerate to set
steps.detail: Refrigerate. Ready in 1 hour for thin slices, overnight for chunks. Keeps 3-4 weeks.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather everything; take the steak out of the fridge 45 min before cooking for even cooking.

steps.label: Bring steak to room temp
steps.detail: Let the steak sit out 45 min so room-temperature meat cooks more evenly.

steps.label: Pat dry and season
steps.detail: Pat dry. Season generously with kosher salt and black pepper on both sides. Optional: garlic powder, smoked paprika.

steps.label: Preheat the pan
steps.detail: Heat a cast iron pan or grill until very hot, 4-5 min on high. Add 1 tbsp neutral oil and wait until it smokes faintly. Open a window.

steps.label: Sear the steak
steps.detail: Lay the steak in away from you. Don't touch it for 3 min. Flip once, 2-3 more min for medium-rare. Pull at 125F.

steps.label: Rest the steak
steps.detail: Rest 5-10 min before slicing. Non-negotiable; it'll climb to 130F.

steps.label: Slice against the grain
steps.detail: Slice against the grain: find the lines in the meat and cut perpendicular to them for tender results.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather 3 eggs, butter, salt, pepper, and optional gruyere or chives.

steps.label: Beat and salt the eggs
steps.detail: Crack eggs into a bowl. Beat thoroughly with a fork until fully homogeneous, no streaks. Salt and whisk again.

steps.label: Melt butter in the pan
steps.detail: Heat an 8-inch non-stick pan over medium-low. Add butter; as soon as it melts and stops foaming (do NOT brown), it's ready.

steps.label: Stir into soft curds
steps.detail: Pour in eggs. Stir with a silicone spatula in small circles while shaking the pan. Constant motion, 30-45 sec, until small curds form.

steps.label: Settle and add filling
steps.detail: When eggs are mostly set but glossy, stop stirring. Tap the handle to settle into an even layer. Optional: sprinkle cheese or chives on one half.

steps.label: Fold and roll onto plate
steps.detail: Tilt the pan away. Fold the far edge to the middle, then roll out onto a plate seam-side down like a tidy cigar.

steps.label: Brush and finish
steps.detail: Brush the top with a tiny bit of butter for sheen. Sprinkle with finishing salt.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather and measure all ingredients; dice bacon, onion, garlic.

steps.label: Wash and ribbon greens
steps.detail: Wash thoroughly to remove grit. Strip leaves off tough stems. Stack, roll like cigars, slice into 1-inch ribbons.

steps.label: Render the bacon
steps.detail: In a Dutch oven over medium heat, cook the bacon until crispy and the fat has rendered (8 min).

steps.label: Soften the onion
steps.detail: Add the onion. Cook 6 min until soft.

steps.label: Add garlic and chili
steps.detail: Add garlic and red pepper flakes. Cook 1 min until fragrant.

steps.label: Wilt in the greens
steps.detail: Add the greens by the handful, letting each wilt before adding more. The volume reduces dramatically.

steps.label: Cover and braise
steps.detail: Pour in broth, bring to a simmer. Cover, reduce heat to low, simmer 40-50 min until tender. Stir every 15 min.

steps.label: Uncover and reduce
steps.detail: Uncover. Cook 5 more min to reduce liquid.

steps.label: Season and serve
steps.detail: Off heat, stir in vinegar. Salt to taste (bacon and broth are salty). Serve with hot sauce.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather and measure all ingredients; mince garlic, slice lemon.

steps.label: Preheat oven to 425F
steps.detail: Preheat oven to 425F so it's ready for roasting.

steps.label: Toss vegetables
steps.detail: Toss the vegetables with 2 tbsp oil, salt, pepper. Spread on a sheet pan.

steps.label: Season the salmon
steps.detail: Pat the salmon dry. Rub with 1 tbsp oil, garlic, salt, pepper, paprika, dill.

steps.label: Pre-roast slow veg
steps.detail: If using slow vegetables (broccoli, green beans), roast them alone for 8 min first. (Quick veg like asparagus or tomatoes: skip and add with salmon.)

steps.label: Add salmon to pan
steps.detail: Nestle the seasoned salmon among the vegetables. Top each fillet with a lemon slice.

steps.label: Roast salmon and veg
steps.detail: Roast 12-15 min until salmon flakes and reads 125F at the thickest point.

steps.label: Finish with lemon
steps.detail: Squeeze fresh lemon juice over everything before serving.

steps.label: Dice potatoes, onion, pepper; beat eggs
steps.detail: Dice potatoes small, dice the onion and bell pepper, beat the 10 eggs, drain the beans, shred the cheese. Set everything in reach for the line.

steps.label: Crisp potatoes with onion and pepper
steps.detail: Heat oil in a skillet. Cook diced potatoes with onion and pepper over medium-high 12-15 min until crispy and tender. Season with salt, pepper, cumin. (If using sausage, cook it now too.) Set aside.

steps.label: Soft-scramble the eggs
steps.detail: While the potatoes crisp, scramble the beaten eggs softly in a little butter. Pull them off heat slightly underdone (they finish when reheated). Season with salt.

steps.label: Warm tortillas until pliable
steps.detail: Warm the 8 tortillas in a dry pan or microwave so they roll without cracking.

steps.label: Fill and roll the burritos
steps.detail: On each tortilla: a line of eggs, potatoes, beans, cheese, sausage if using — don't overfill. Fold in the sides, then roll tightly from the bottom.

steps.label: Sear, wrap, and freeze
steps.detail: Optional: sear seam-side down in a dry hot skillet 1 min to seal. Wrap each burrito tightly in foil or parchment, then place in a freezer bag.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather patties, salt, pepper; set up the skillet station.

steps.label: Heat the skillet
steps.detail: Heat skillet over medium — not high — until it's hot.

steps.label: Cook the patties
steps.detail: Add patties, season the top with salt and pepper. Cook 5–7 min per side, flip once, ~12–15 min total.

steps.label: Check temp & serve
steps.detail: Confirm internal 160°F (71°C) for beef, then plate.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Measure butter and flavorings; lay out parchment or wrap.

steps.label: Soften the butter
steps.detail: Soften 1 stick (½ cup / 113g) unsalted butter at room temp until it gives easily to a spoon.

steps.label: Mash in flavorings
steps.detail: Mash in the flavorings with a fork or rubber spatula.

steps.label: Roll into a log
steps.detail: Scrape onto parchment or wrap. Roll into a log ~1 inch thick. Twist the ends.

steps.label: Refrigerate to firm
steps.detail: Refrigerate 1 hour to firm up, or freeze indefinitely. Slice coins off as needed.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather yogurt, sweetener, and toppings; grab a bowl.

steps.label: Spoon yogurt & sweeten
steps.detail: Spoon skyr or Greek yogurt into a bowl and stir in your sweetener of choice.

steps.label: Add toppings & serve
steps.detail: Top with fruit, granola, nuts, or honey and serve.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Measure flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, milk, egg, melted butter, vanilla.

steps.label: Warm the oven
steps.detail: Set oven to 200°F with a wire rack to keep finished pancakes warm.

steps.label: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.detail: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.

steps.label: Whisk wet ingredients
steps.detail: In another bowl, whisk milk, egg, melted butter, and vanilla.

steps.label: Combine into batter
steps.detail: Pour wet into dry. Whisk just until combined — lumps are fine. Don't overmix.

steps.label: Rest the batter
steps.detail: Let the batter rest 5 minutes so baking powder activates and gluten relaxes.

steps.label: Heat the skillet
steps.detail: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium and melt ½ tsp butter.

steps.label: Cook the pancakes
steps.detail: Ladle ¼ cup batter each. Cook ~2 min until bubbles form and edges dry, flip once, 1–2 min more. Keep warm in the oven on the rack.

steps.label: Salt eggplant; prep vegetables
steps.detail: Cube 1 eggplant, toss with 1 tsp salt in a colander, and let sit 20 min to draw out bitter water (pat dry after). Meanwhile cube zucchini, dice bell peppers and onion, mince garlic.

steps.label: Brown the eggplant
steps.detail: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high. Add the patted-dry eggplant. Cook 6-8 min until deeply browned and tender. Remove to a plate.

steps.label: Brown the zucchini
steps.detail: Add 1 tbsp more oil. Add zucchini and cook 5 min until golden-edged but still firm. Remove to the eggplant plate.

steps.label: Soften the bell peppers
steps.detail: Add 1 tbsp more oil. Add bell pepper and cook 4 min until soft. Remove to the plate.

steps.label: Build onion-tomato base
steps.detail: Add the last tbsp oil and the onion; cook 6 min until translucent. Add garlic, tomato paste, and herbs; stir 1 min. Add crushed tomatoes and 1/2 tsp salt; bring to a simmer and cook 5 min.

steps.label: Return vegetables & simmer
steps.detail: Return all the cooked vegetables and stir gently to combine. Reduce heat and simmer 15 min uncovered to let flavors marry and excess liquid evaporate.

steps.label: Tear basil; ready bread
steps.detail: Tear fresh basil and warm crusty bread to serve alongside. Done during the simmer.

steps.label: Finish, rest & serve
steps.detail: Off heat, drizzle with olive oil and tear in the basil. Rest 10 min before serving (or fully cool — ratatouille is often better at room temp).

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Cut tops off peppers and seed them, dice onion, mince garlic, measure tomatoes, paste, spices, cheese, cooked rice.

steps.label: Preheat oven
steps.detail: Preheat oven to 375°F.

steps.label: Brown the beef
steps.detail: Brown the beef in a skillet over medium-high, 6 min. Drain.

steps.label: Cook onion & spices
steps.detail: Add onion, cook 5 min. Add garlic, tomato paste, and spices; cook 1 min.

steps.label: Simmer the filling
steps.detail: Add diced tomatoes (reserve ½ cup for the dish) and cooked rice. Stir, simmer 5 min, season, then stir in half the cheese.

steps.label: Stuff the peppers
steps.detail: Spread reserved tomatoes in the baking dish. Stand peppers upright, fill with the meat-rice mixture mounding on top, and top with remaining cheese.

steps.label: Bake covered
steps.detail: Cover with foil and bake 30 min.

steps.label: Bake uncovered
steps.detail: Uncover and bake 15 more min until peppers are tender and cheese is bubbling and golden.

steps.label: Dice onion & mince garlic
steps.detail: Dice the onion and mince the garlic. Measure out the tomato paste, broth, sugar, and dried basil.

steps.label: Soften onion & bloom paste
steps.detail: Melt butter in a pot over medium. Add onion + pinch of salt, cook 6 min until soft. Add garlic and tomato paste, stir 2 min.

steps.label: Simmer the tomatoes
steps.detail: Add canned tomatoes (crush whole ones with your spoon), broth, sugar and dried basil. Bring to a simmer and cook 15 min.

steps.label: Make toast / grilled cheese
steps.detail: While the soup simmers, toast or griddle bread for a grilled cheese to serve alongside, and pick fresh basil leaves for garnish.

steps.label: Blend & finish with cream
steps.detail: Use an immersion blender to puree until smooth (or blend in batches). Stir in the cream and heat through without boiling. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.label: Garnish & serve
steps.detail: Ladle into bowls, top with fresh basil, and serve with the toast or grilled cheese.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather and measure all powders, seeds, and liquids. Clear and wipe the counter.

steps.label: Blend the smoothie
steps.detail: Add all ingredients with liquid to the blender and blend until smooth.

steps.label: Pour and serve
steps.detail: Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather chickpeas, oil, salt, and spices. Clear the counter.

steps.label: Preheat oven to 400F
steps.detail: Preheat the oven to 400F while you prep the chickpeas.

steps.label: Drain and dry chickpeas
steps.detail: Drain and rinse 2 cans of chickpeas. Dry aggressively with paper towels, then air-dry on a towel 10 min. Rub off any loose skins.

steps.label: Toss with oil and salt
steps.detail: Toss the dried chickpeas with 2 tbsp olive oil and 1/2 tsp salt only, no spices yet. Spread on a sheet pan in a single layer.

steps.label: Roast until crispy
steps.detail: Roast 25-30 min, shaking the pan every 10 min, until deeply golden and they rattle when shaken.

steps.label: Season while hot
steps.detail: Toss with spices immediately while still hot.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Drain and rinse the beans. Gather dressing ingredients and produce.

steps.label: Whisk the dressing
steps.detail: Whisk olive oil, red wine vinegar, Dijon, grated garlic, salt, and pepper in the bottom of a large bowl.

steps.label: Dice the vegetables
steps.detail: Finely dice the red onion, bell pepper, and cucumber. Chop the parsley.

steps.label: Toss and adjust
steps.detail: Add beans, vegetables, and parsley to the bowl. Toss. Taste and adjust salt, vinegar, oil.

steps.label: Let flavors marry
steps.detail: Let sit 15 min before serving so flavors marry (or refrigerate up to 4 days).

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather bread, eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, salt, and butter.

steps.label: Whisk the custard
steps.detail: Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt in a wide shallow dish.

steps.label: Heat the skillet
steps.detail: Heat a non-stick or cast iron skillet over medium. Melt 1 tbsp butter.

steps.label: Dunk the bread
steps.detail: Dunk each slice in the custard, 30 sec per side. Don't oversoak or the inside gets gummy.

steps.label: Cook until golden
steps.detail: Add bread to the skillet. Cook 2-3 min per side until deep golden brown, crisp, and caramelized.

steps.label: Keep warm and serve
steps.detail: Keep warm in a 200F oven while cooking the rest, then serve.

steps.label: Dice onion, carrot, celery; mince garlic
steps.detail: Dice the onion, carrot, and celery for the soffritto. Mince the garlic for the pot. Measure the broth and find the parmesan rind.

steps.label: Mix and roll tiny meatballs
steps.detail: Mix ground turkey, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, minced garlic, parsley, and salt. Roll into marble-sized half-inch meatballs — the signature of the dish.

steps.label: Saute soffritto, add garlic
steps.detail: In a large pot, saute onion, carrot, and celery in olive oil 6 min. Add garlic and cook 1 min.

steps.label: Add broth & rind, bring to simmer
steps.detail: Add the broth and parmesan rind. Bring to a simmer.

steps.label: Simmer the meatballs
steps.detail: Drop the meatballs into the simmering broth. Simmer 10 min — they'll float when done.

steps.label: Wash greens, grate parmesan, cut lemon
steps.detail: While the meatballs simmer, wash and roughly chop the greens, grate parmesan for topping, and halve the lemon for finishing.

steps.label: Cook pasta, wilt greens
steps.detail: Add the pasta and cook per package time (usually 8 min). Add the greens in the last 2 min and cook until wilted.

steps.label: Finish with lemon and parmesan
steps.detail: Off heat, remove the parmesan rind, squeeze in lemon, and top each bowl with grated parmesan.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Dice onion, slice carrots and celery, mince garlic. Gather chicken, aromatics, and noodles.

steps.label: Saute the vegetables
steps.detail: In a large pot, saute onion, carrot, celery in olive oil 6 min. Add garlic, 1 min.

steps.label: Add chicken and water
steps.detail: Add the chicken, water, bay leaves, thyme, peppercorns, and 1 tsp salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and skim any foam.

steps.label: Simmer the broth
steps.detail: Simmer 45 min until the chicken is fully cooked and the broth tastes rich.

steps.label: Pull and shred chicken
steps.detail: Remove the chicken, cool slightly, then pull the meat off the bones and shred. Discard skin and bones. Fish out the bay, thyme, and peppercorns.

steps.label: Cook the noodles
steps.detail: Bring the broth back to a simmer. Add the noodles and cook per package time.

steps.label: Return chicken and season
steps.detail: Return the shredded chicken and heat through. Season generously with salt and pepper. Stir in fresh dill or parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

steps.label: Prep aromatics & spices
steps.detail: Finely dice 1 large onion. Mince 4 garlic cloves and grate 1 tbsp ginger. Measure the dry spices (cumin, coriander, garam masala, turmeric, cayenne) and tomato paste. Drain 2 cans chickpeas.

steps.label: Brown the onion
steps.detail: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a pot over medium-high. Add onion and a pinch of salt. Cook 8 min until deeply golden — this depth of color matters.

steps.label: Add aromatics, bloom spices & tomato
steps.detail: Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 min. Add the dry spices and tomato paste; stir 2 min to bloom in the oil (splash of water if it sticks). Add diced tomatoes and cook 5 min until they break down and oil separates at the edges.

steps.label: Simmer & mash the chickpeas
steps.detail: Add chickpeas and 1 cup water; stir. Simmer 10-15 min, mashing some chickpeas against the side of the pot to thicken the gravy.

steps.label: Cook rice for serving
steps.detail: Start rice (or warm naan/roti) so it finishes alongside the curry. Cooks unattended during the simmer.

steps.label: Chop cilantro & cut lemon
steps.detail: Roughly chop cilantro and halve the lemon for finishing. Done during the simmer.

steps.label: Finish & season
steps.detail: Off heat, add the juice of half a lemon and season with salt. Top with cilantro.

steps.label: Serve with rice or naan
steps.detail: Ladle curry over the cooked rice (or serve with naan/roti).

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Cut root veg into 1-inch chunks, wedge the onion, measure oil and spices.

steps.label: Preheat oven to 425F
steps.detail: Preheat oven to 425F while you prep the veg and chicken.

steps.label: Toss & spread the veg
steps.detail: Toss the veg with 1 tbsp oil, salt, pepper, paprika. Spread on a sheet pan.

steps.label: Pat & season chicken
steps.detail: Pat chicken dry (wet skin won't crisp). Rub with remaining oil, season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, thyme.

steps.label: Nest chicken on veg
steps.detail: Nest the chicken skin-side up on top of the veg.

steps.label: Roast the sheet pan
steps.detail: Roast 35-40 min until skin is deep golden and thighs hit 175F.

steps.label: Serve
steps.detail: Pull the pan and serve the chicken and roasted veg.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Dice the onion, mince the garlic, measure oil, salt, sugar, and open the tomatoes.

steps.label: Boil pasta water
steps.detail: Salt a big pot of water and bring to a boil for the pasta.

steps.label: Soften the onion
steps.detail: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Add onion and a pinch of salt. Cook 5 min until soft.

steps.label: Add garlic & chili
steps.detail: Add garlic and red pepper. Cook 1 min - don't let it brown.

steps.label: Simmer the sauce
steps.detail: Pour in the tomatoes, add salt and sugar, bring to a simmer, then reduce and simmer uncovered 15 min, stirring occasionally.

steps.label: Cook the pasta
steps.detail: Add pasta to the boiling water as the sauce starts simmering. Cook 1 minute less than the package says.

steps.label: Drain, save pasta water
steps.detail: Reserve 1 cup pasta water. Drain pasta. Add pasta to the sauce skillet with 1/2 cup pasta water.

steps.label: Toss to emulsify
steps.detail: Toss over medium heat 1 minute until sauce clings to every strand. Add more pasta water if dry.

steps.label: Finish & serve
steps.detail: Off heat, drizzle with olive oil, fresh basil, and grated parmesan.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather rice paper sheets, soy, maple, smoked paprika, and a little oil. Line a baking sheet.

steps.label: Preheat oven
steps.detail: Preheat oven (or air fryer) to crisp the rice paper bacon.

steps.label: Mix the glaze
steps.detail: Stir together soy, maple, smoked paprika, and a tiny bit of oil into a brushing glaze.

steps.label: Cut & brush strips
steps.detail: Cut the rice paper into bacon-width strips and brush both sides with the glaze.

steps.label: Bake until it shatters
steps.detail: Bake or air-fry the strips until deep golden and crisp - a vegan bacon that actually shatters.

steps.label: Cool & serve
steps.detail: Let the rice paper bacon cool briefly so it crisps fully, then serve.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Get bread, mayo, and cheese ready; grab a lid for the pan.

steps.label: Build the sandwich
steps.detail: Spread mayo thinly but completely on the OUTSIDE of each slice. Layer cheese on the INSIDE of one slice and close.

steps.label: Cover & brown side 1
steps.detail: Heat a non-stick or cast iron pan over medium-low. Add the sandwich and cover with a lid - trapped steam melts the cheese in sync with browning. 3-4 min until deep golden.

steps.label: Flip & brown side 2
steps.detail: Flip the sandwich, cover again, and cook 3 more minutes until golden.

steps.label: Rest & cut
steps.detail: Rest 1 min before cutting so the cheese sets instead of running out.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Measure spices, grate garlic, juice the lemon, and have the yogurt, oil, and chicken ready.

steps.label: Marinate the chicken
steps.detail: Combine marinade ingredients in a bowl or bag, add chicken, coat well. Marinate at least 1 hour, ideally overnight.

steps.label: Preheat oven to 425F
steps.detail: Preheat oven to 425F.

steps.label: Spread on sheet pan
steps.detail: Spread chicken on a sheet pan (with sliced onion underneath if you like). Don't crowd.

steps.label: Roast the chicken
steps.detail: Roast 30-35 min until edges are charred and chicken hits 175F.

steps.label: Broil for char
steps.detail: Optional broil 2-3 min at the end for crispy charred edges - the shawarma signature.

steps.label: Rest & slice
steps.detail: Rest 5 min, then slice into strips.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Cube and season the beef, dice the onion, chunk carrots and celery, mince garlic, measure broth, wine, and tomato paste.

steps.label: Flour the beef
steps.detail: Pat the beef dry, season with salt and pepper, then toss with flour to coat.

steps.label: Brown the beef
steps.detail: Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high. Brown the beef in batches - don't crowd, build a deep crust. Remove to a plate.

steps.label: Cook the aromatics
steps.detail: Add onion, carrot, and celery to the pot. Cook 6 min.

steps.label: Garlic & tomato paste
steps.detail: Add garlic and tomato paste. Stir 2 min.

steps.label: Deglaze with wine
steps.detail: Pour in the wine, scrape up all the brown bits from the bottom, and simmer 2 min.

steps.label: Braise the stew
steps.detail: Return the beef, add broth, bay leaves, thyme, Worcestershire (liquid should nearly cover). Bring to a simmer, cover, and braise at lowest simmer for 2 hours.

steps.label: Add the potatoes
steps.detail: Add the potatoes. Cook 30-45 more min until beef and potatoes are fork-tender.

steps.label: Stir in the peas
steps.detail: Stir in frozen peas. Cook 5 min.

steps.label: Season & serve
steps.detail: Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Remove bay leaves and serve.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Measure the seasonings and Worcestershire, set out the bison, buns, oil, cheese, and toppings.

steps.label: Mix the bison
steps.detail: Gently mix the bison with Worcestershire and seasonings. Don't overwork - overworked lean meat gets dense and tough.

steps.label: Form the patties
steps.detail: Form into 4 patties slightly wider than the buns (they shrink). Press a thumb-dent into each center to prevent doming.

steps.label: Sear the patties
steps.detail: Heat cast iron or grill over medium-high. Brush patties with olive oil. Cook 3-4 min per side, pulling at 145-150F - NOT 160 like beef.

steps.label: Melt the cheese
steps.detail: Add cheese in the last minute and cover to melt.

steps.label: Toast the buns
steps.detail: Toast the buns while the patties rest.

steps.label: Rest & assemble
steps.detail: Rest the patties 3 min, then assemble the burgers on the toasted buns with toppings.

steps.label: Prep onion, carrot & aromatics
steps.detail: Dice 1 onion and 2 carrots. Mince 3 garlic cloves. Measure tomato paste and spices (cumin, paprika, turmeric). Rinse 1 cup red lentils until the water runs clear.

steps.label: Soften onion & carrot
steps.detail: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pot over medium. Add onion, carrot, and a pinch of salt. Cook 6-8 min until soft.

steps.label: Add garlic, paste & spices
steps.detail: Add garlic, tomato paste, and spices. Stir 1 min until fragrant.

steps.label: Simmer until lentils dissolve
steps.detail: Add lentils and 6 cups water or broth. Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, cover partially. Cook 20-25 min, stirring occasionally, until lentils dissolve.

steps.label: Cut lemon & ready bread
steps.detail: Halve the lemon for finishing and warm crusty bread to serve. Done during the simmer.

steps.label: Season & brighten with lemon
steps.detail: Season with salt. Squeeze in the juice of half a lemon at the end — critical, it brightens everything.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather potato, oil, coarse salt, and toppings.

steps.label: Preheat oven to 425F
steps.detail: Preheat oven to 425F.

steps.label: Scrub and dry the potato
steps.detail: Scrub a russet potato (the big brown oblong ones - Yukon Gold is too waxy for this). Pat dry.

steps.label: Stab, oil, and salt
steps.detail: Stab all over 6-8 times with a fork for steam escape. Rub with 1 tsp oil and a generous pinch of coarse salt so it sticks to the skin and dehydrates into a chip-like crust.

steps.label: Bake directly on the rack
steps.detail: Place directly on the oven rack (not a baking sheet - air needs to circulate). Bake 60-75 min until a knife slides through with no resistance.

steps.label: Crack open to vent steam
steps.detail: Squeeze the ends to crack it open. Steam needs to escape or the interior gums up. Top and serve.

steps.label: Dice onions & pepper, mince garlic
steps.detail: Dice the onions and bell pepper, mince the garlic, and measure out chili powder, cumin, paprika, oregano, cocoa, and tomato paste so the bloom step moves fast.

steps.label: Brown the beef for crust
steps.detail: Heat a Dutch oven over medium-high. Brown the beef in two batches if needed — you want crust, not steam. 8 min. Drain excess fat, keeping 1 tbsp.

steps.label: Soften aromatics, bloom spices
steps.detail: Add onions and pepper, 5 min until soft. Add garlic, tomato paste, all spices, and cocoa; stir 2 min until the spices darken and smell deeply toasted.

steps.label: Simmer chili 60-90 min
steps.detail: Add crushed tomatoes, broth, brown sugar, and drained beans; salt to taste. Bring to a simmer, reduce to low, and simmer 60-90 min uncovered, stirring every 15 min. Add a splash of water if it gets too thick.

steps.label: Cook rice for serving
steps.detail: While the chili simmers, cook a pot of rice to serve under or alongside the chili. Rinse, simmer covered until tender, then keep warm.

steps.label: Grate cheese, prep chili toppings
steps.detail: While the chili simmers, grate cheddar, slice scallions and jalapeno, chop cilantro, and set out sour cream and lime wedges.

steps.label: Rest, then balance with vinegar
steps.detail: Off heat, stir in the apple cider vinegar. Taste and adjust salt, vinegar, and hot sauce. Let it rest 15 min before serving.

steps.label: Serve chili over rice with toppings
steps.detail: Ladle the rested chili over the warm rice and finish with the grated cheese and prepared toppings.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Shred cheese, prep fillings (cooked chicken, beans, sauteed veg), set out two 10-inch flour tortillas.

steps.label: Heat the pan
steps.detail: Heat a non-stick or cast iron pan over medium.

steps.label: Build the quesadilla
steps.detail: Add 1 tortilla. Top with shredded cheese spread to the edges, then fillings, then a second layer of cheese as glue. Top with the second tortilla.

steps.label: Cook and flip
steps.detail: Cook 2 min until the bottom is golden and crispy. Slide a spatula under, flip, and cook 2 more min until the cheese is fully melted.

steps.label: Rest and cut
steps.detail: Slide onto a cutting board. Rest 1 min, then cut into wedges.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Grate ginger, beat eggs, slice scallions, mix the cornstarch slurry (2 tbsp cornstarch + 3 tbsp cold water).

steps.label: Simmer the broth
steps.detail: Bring broth, soy sauce, ginger, and sesame oil to a gentle simmer in a pot.

steps.label: Thicken with slurry
steps.detail: Stir the cornstarch slurry, then pour into the broth while stirring. It thickens into a silky body. Simmer 1 min.

steps.label: Drizzle the egg ribbons
steps.detail: Stir the soup in a slow circle. While stirring, slowly drizzle the beaten eggs in a thin stream to create delicate ribbons. Turn off the heat immediately after.

steps.label: Scallions and season
steps.detail: Stir in scallions and white pepper. Taste and add salt if needed.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Set out tortillas, eggs, beans, salsa, and toppings (avocado, cilantro, crumbled cheese, lime, hot sauce).

steps.label: Warm the refried beans
steps.detail: Warm the refried beans in a small pot.

steps.label: Warm the salsa
steps.detail: Warm the salsa in another small pot - warm salsa is traditional and better than cold.

steps.label: Warm the tortillas
steps.detail: Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet, 30 sec per side. Keep them warm.

steps.label: Fry the eggs
steps.detail: Fry the eggs in a little oil - sunny side up or over easy. Runny yolk is essential.

steps.label: Assemble and top
steps.detail: Place 2 tortillas per plate, slightly overlapping. Spread refried beans over them, top each with 2 fried eggs, and spoon warm salsa around (not over) the yolks. Finish with avocado, cilantro, cheese, lime, and hot sauce.

steps.label: Dice onions and pepper; mince garlic
steps.detail: Dice the onions and bell pepper, mince the garlic, and measure out the chili powder, cumin, paprika, oregano, and cocoa. Drain the beans.

steps.label: Brown the bison
steps.detail: Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high. Brown the ground bison 6-8 min, breaking it up. (Bison renders less fat than beef, so the oil matters.)

steps.label: Cook aromatics and bloom spices
steps.detail: Add onions and pepper; cook 6 min. Add garlic, tomato paste, all spices, and cocoa; stir 2 min until fragrant and the spices darken.

steps.label: Simmer the chili low and slow
steps.detail: Add crushed tomatoes, broth, brown sugar, and beans; stir. Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low, and simmer 60-75 min, stirring occasionally.

steps.label: Cook rice for serving
steps.detail: While the chili simmers, cook a pot of rice to spoon the chili over (or warm cornbread). Cover and hold.

steps.label: Prep toppings
steps.detail: During the simmer, grate cheese, slice scallions, chop cilantro, and set out sour cream and hot sauce for the chili bar.

steps.label: Stir in vinegar and season
steps.detail: Off heat, stir in the vinegar. Season with salt and hot sauce to taste.

steps.label: Serve over rice with toppings
steps.detail: Ladle the chili over the cooked rice and let everyone add toppings from the bar.

steps.label: Drain soaked beans, start the pot
steps.detail: Drain the overnight-soaked (or quick-soaked) beans. Add to a pot, cover with fresh water, ready to heat. No salt yet.

steps.label: Simmer beans until tender
steps.detail: Bring beans to a boil, reduce to a simmer, cook 45-60 min until tender (no salt — it can toughen skins). Then drain, reserving the cooking liquid.

steps.label: Dice onion, pepper; mince garlic
steps.detail: While the beans simmer, dice the onion and bell pepper, mince the garlic, and measure out tomato paste, cumin, oregano, smoked paprika, and the bay leaf.

steps.label: Rinse rice, prep lime & cilantro
steps.detail: While the beans simmer, rinse the long-grain rice until water runs clear. Cut the lime into wedges and roughly chop cilantro for finishing.

steps.label: Saute aromatics, bloom spices
steps.detail: In the same pot: heat oil, cook onion and pepper 5 min. Add garlic, tomato paste, and spices; stir 1 min until fragrant.

steps.label: Add beans, liquid, rice; cook covered
steps.detail: Return beans, add 4 cups liquid (bean broth + water), bring to a boil. Stir in rinsed rice, cover, drop to lowest heat, cook 18 min undisturbed.

steps.label: Rest, fluff, season, serve
steps.detail: Off heat 10 min, still covered. Fluff with a fork. Season with salt and lime juice; scatter cilantro and serve.

steps.label: Dice onion & pepper, mince garlic
steps.detail: Dice the onion and red bell pepper. Mince the garlic. Measure out tomato paste, cumin, smoked paprika, and chili powder.

steps.label: Soften onion & pepper
steps.detail: Heat oil in a large skillet (cast iron is ideal) over medium. Add onion and pepper with a pinch of salt; cook 8 min until soft.

steps.label: Bloom spices, add tomatoes
steps.detail: Add garlic, tomato paste, cumin, paprika, chili; stir 1 min. Pour in the can of tomatoes.

steps.label: Simmer sauce until thickened
steps.detail: Simmer 8-10 min until thickened — it should look like loose pasta sauce.

steps.label: Warm bread, chop herbs, crumble feta
steps.detail: While the sauce simmers, warm the bread or pita, chop the parsley or cilantro, and crumble the feta so toppings are ready.

steps.label: Make wells, poach the eggs
steps.detail: Make 4-6 wells in the sauce with the back of a spoon, crack an egg into each, salt the eggs, cover the pan, and cook 5-8 min until whites are set but yolks runny.

steps.label: Top and serve from the pan
steps.detail: Top with the chopped herbs and crumbled feta. Serve straight from the pan with the warmed bread.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Grate onion and garlic, chop parsley, measure breadcrumbs, milk, parmesan, eggs and ground meat.

steps.label: Soak the panade
steps.detail: Combine breadcrumbs and milk in a bowl. Let sit 5 min until milk is absorbed to keep meatballs tender.

steps.label: Preheat oven
steps.detail: Heat oven to 400F and line a sheet pan with parchment.

steps.label: Mix the meat
steps.detail: Add everything else to the bowl. Mix gently with your hands until just combined; do not overmix or meatballs turn tough.

steps.label: Test seasoning
steps.detail: Cook one tiny meatball in a pan, taste, and adjust salt in the mix.

steps.label: Roll the meatballs
steps.detail: Roll into balls, wetting your hands between rolls; golf-ball size for spaghetti, ping-pong for soup.

steps.label: Bake the meatballs
steps.detail: Bake at 400F on the parchment sheet pan for 18 min.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Everything chopped and within reach, sauce mixed, protein and vegetables sorted by hardness. You can't stop to chop once you start.

steps.label: Heat the wok
steps.detail: Heat wok over high until smoking. Add 1 tbsp oil.

steps.label: Sear the protein
steps.detail: Add protein in a single layer. Don't stir 30 sec to build crust, then stir-fry 1-2 min. Remove to a plate.

steps.label: Stir-fry aromatics & veg
steps.detail: Add 1 tbsp oil, then aromatics 15 sec. Add hard veg 2 min tossing constantly, then medium veg 1 min.

steps.label: Return protein & sauce
steps.detail: Return protein. Pour sauce around the edge of the wok and toss to coat, about 30 sec until thickened and glossy.

steps.label: Soft veg & plate
steps.detail: Add soft vegetables and scallion greens, toss 30 sec. Off heat, plate and serve over rice immediately.

steps.label: Prep onion, pepper & aromatics
steps.detail: Dice 1 onion and 1 bell pepper. Mince 4 garlic cloves. Measure tomato paste and spices (cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, chili powder). Drain 3 cans black beans.

steps.label: Cook onion & pepper
steps.detail: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pot over medium. Add onion, bell pepper, and a pinch of salt. Cook 6 min.

steps.label: Add garlic, paste & spices
steps.detail: Add garlic, tomato paste, and all spices. Stir 1 min until fragrant.

steps.label: Simmer beans & broth
steps.detail: Add beans and 4 cups broth. Bring to a simmer and cook 15 min.

steps.label: Cut lime & prep toppings
steps.detail: Halve the lime and ready any toppings (cilantro, sour cream, avocado). Done during the simmer.

steps.label: Blend half for body
steps.detail: Use an immersion blender to puree about half the soup, leaving half chunky (or blend 2 cups in a blender and return).

steps.label: Finish with lime & salt
steps.detail: Off heat, stir in the juice of 1 lime. Salt to taste. Serve with the toppings.

steps.label: Dice soffritto and mince garlic
steps.detail: Dice the onion, carrots, and celery; mince the garlic. Drain the beans and measure the broth.

steps.label: Sauté soffritto with tomato paste
steps.detail: Heat oil in a large pot. Sauté onion, carrot, celery 6 min. Add garlic, tomato paste, and dried herbs; stir 1 min.

steps.label: Simmer broth with beans and hard veg
steps.detail: Add diced tomatoes, beans, broth, parmesan rind, and bay leaf. Bring to a simmer, add hard vegetables (potato, green beans), and simmer 15 min.

steps.label: Prep medium veg and greens
steps.detail: While the broth simmers, dice zucchini and shred cabbage, and wash and chop the kale or spinach for the finish. Grate parmesan for serving.

steps.label: Add pasta and medium veg
steps.detail: Add the small pasta and medium vegetables (zucchini, cabbage) to the simmering soup. Cook 10 min.

steps.label: Wilt greens and adjust
steps.detail: Stir in the leafy greens for the last 3 min. Remove the parmesan rind and bay leaf; season with salt and pepper.

steps.label: Serve with parmesan and oil
steps.detail: Ladle into bowls; top with grated parmesan and a drizzle of good olive oil.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Smash garlic, set out thyme/rosemary, oil and butter; pat steaks dry and season generously with salt and pepper.

steps.label: Temper the venison
steps.detail: Take the venison out of the fridge 30-45 min before cooking so it comes toward room temperature.

steps.label: Heat cast iron pan
steps.detail: Heat a cast iron pan over high until very hot (4-5 min). Add the oil and wait until it shimmers and just starts to smoke.

steps.label: Sear the steaks
steps.detail: Lay the steaks in away from you. Don't touch them for 2-3 min to develop a deep crust, then flip and cook 2 more min.

steps.label: Butter-baste to temp
steps.detail: Reduce to medium, add butter, garlic and herbs. Tilt the pan and spoon the foaming butter over the steaks 60-90 sec. Pull at 125-130F for medium-rare.

steps.label: Rest & slice
steps.detail: Rest 5-10 min (essential for lean game meat), then slice thin against the grain.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather oil, lemon, butter and seasonings; clear the counter and ready a plate.

steps.label: Thaw the fillets
steps.detail: Place sealed fillets in a bowl of cold water for 10-15 min until thawed.

steps.label: Dry & season fish
steps.detail: Pat fillets aggressively dry with paper towel, then season both sides with salt, pepper and a dust of paprika or garlic powder.

steps.label: Heat the pan
steps.detail: Heat a non-stick or cast iron pan over medium-high with 1 tbsp oil until shimmering.

steps.label: Sear first side
steps.detail: Lay fish in away from you. Don't touch it for 3 minutes.

steps.label: Flip & finish
steps.detail: Flip once and cook 2 more minutes, until it flakes with a fork at the thickest point.

steps.label: Lemon & butter finish
steps.detail: Off heat, add a squeeze of lemon and a knob of butter to swirl in the pan; plate.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Crack eggs, grate cheese, dice onion and any veg, measure milk and butter.

steps.label: Preheat oven
steps.detail: Preheat oven to 375F.

steps.label: Whisk egg mixture
steps.detail: Whisk eggs with milk, salt and pepper. Stir in half the cheese.

steps.label: Cook the onion
steps.detail: Heat butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium. Cook onion 5 min until soft.

steps.label: Cook the vegetables
steps.detail: Add any raw vegetables and cook until tender. Spread evenly across the pan.

steps.label: Pour eggs & set edges
steps.detail: Pour egg mixture over the vegetables, tilt to spread, then cook on the stovetop 2 min until edges set.

steps.label: Top & bake
steps.detail: Sprinkle remaining cheese over top, transfer to the oven and bake 12-15 min until the center is just set and barely jiggles.

steps.label: Cool & slice
steps.detail: Cool 5 min before slicing.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Rinse lentils, dice onion, mince garlic and ginger, measure spices and tomato paste.

steps.label: Simmer the dal
steps.detail: Combine lentils with water, turmeric, salt and tomato in a pot. Boil, reduce to a simmer, skim foam. Simmer 25-30 min until thick and creamy, whisking briefly at the end.

steps.label: Make the tarka
steps.detail: Heat ghee over medium. Pop cumin and mustard seeds 30 sec. Add onion, cook 5 min until browning. Add garlic, ginger, chili 1 min. Add tomato paste, garam masala and chili powder; stir 2 min.

steps.label: Combine tarka & dal
steps.detail: Pour the entire tarka into the pot of dal. Stir and taste, adjusting salt.

steps.label: Garnish & serve
steps.detail: Top with cilantro and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with rice, naan, or roti.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Slice garlic very thin, chop parsley, measure olive oil and chili flakes.

steps.label: Boil salted water
steps.detail: Bring a big pot of water to a boil. Salt it generously so it tastes like the sea.

steps.label: Cook the pasta
steps.detail: Drop in spaghetti and cook 2 min less than the box says.

steps.label: Cold-start garlic oil
steps.detail: In a wide skillet pour the olive oil, add the sliced garlic, then turn heat on to medium-low. Cook 5-7 min until pale gold, adding chili flakes in the last minute.

steps.label: Add pasta water to oil
steps.detail: Scoop out 1 cup pasta water; add 1/2 cup to the garlic oil. It sizzles violently. Bring to a low simmer.

steps.label: Drain & toss
steps.detail: Drain pasta and add directly to the skillet. Toss over medium heat 1-2 min, splashing in more pasta water if dry, until glossy and emulsified.

steps.label: Finish & plate
steps.detail: Off heat, toss in parsley, plate, drizzle a little more olive oil and optionally grate parmesan.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Dice onion, carrot and celery; juice lemons; crack eggs into a bowl; measure rice and broth.

steps.label: Saute the vegetables
steps.detail: In a large pot, saute onion, carrot and celery in olive oil 6 min.

steps.label: Simmer the chicken
steps.detail: Add broth and chicken thighs. Simmer 15 min until chicken is cooked.

steps.label: Shred the chicken
steps.detail: Remove chicken, shred with two forks, set aside.

steps.label: Simmer the rice
steps.detail: Add rice to the broth. Simmer 15 min until tender.

steps.label: Make the avgolemono
steps.detail: Whisk eggs and lemon juice until frothy, then slowly ladle in 2 cups hot broth while whisking constantly to temper.

steps.label: Stir in egg-lemon
steps.detail: Turn the soup heat OFF. Pour the tempered egg-lemon mixture into the pot, stirring constantly until silky and slightly thickened. Do not boil after this or it curdles.

steps.label: Return chicken & season
steps.detail: Return the shredded chicken and stir. Season with salt and pepper and top with fresh dill.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Measure oats and spices, mash banana, gather wet ingredients and mix-ins.

steps.label: Preheat & grease
steps.detail: Preheat oven to 375F and grease an 8x8 or 9x9 baking dish.

steps.label: Mix dry ingredients
steps.detail: In a bowl, mix oats, baking powder, cinnamon and salt.

steps.label: Whisk wet ingredients
steps.detail: In another bowl, whisk milk, eggs, maple syrup, melted butter, vanilla and mashed banana.

steps.label: Combine & add mix-ins
steps.detail: Combine wet and dry, then stir in half the mix-ins.

steps.label: Pour & bake
steps.detail: Pour into the baking dish, scatter remaining mix-ins on top, and bake 35-40 min until set in the center and golden.

steps.label: Cool & cut
steps.detail: Cool, then cut into 9 squares.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Cube and dry the venison, dice bacon, chop onion, carrot, celery and garlic, measure wine, broth and aromatics.

steps.label: Season & flour venison
steps.detail: Pat the venison dry, season with salt and pepper, and toss with flour.

steps.label: Render the bacon
steps.detail: In a Dutch oven, render the bacon over medium until crisp. Remove the bacon bits, leave the fat.

steps.label: Brown the venison
steps.detail: Brown the venison in batches in the bacon fat plus oil, deep crust on all sides, don't crowd. Remove to a plate.

steps.label: Cook veg & tomato paste
steps.detail: Add onion, carrot and celery. Cook 6 min. Add garlic and tomato paste, 2 min.

steps.label: Deglaze with wine
steps.detail: Pour in the wine, scrape up all the brown bits, and simmer 2 min.

steps.label: Build the braise
steps.detail: Return the venison and bacon. Add broth, bay, thyme, juniper and Worcestershire; liquid should nearly cover the meat. Bring to a simmer.

steps.label: Braise in the oven
steps.detail: Cover and braise at 300F in the oven for 2 hours.

steps.label: Add potatoes & finish
steps.detail: Add potatoes and cook 45 more min until venison and potatoes are fork-tender.

steps.label: Season & serve
steps.detail: Taste, adjust salt and pepper, and remove the bay leaves.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Read the recipe through, gather a cold non-stick pan, butter, eggs, silicone spatula and salt.

steps.label: Crack eggs into cold pan
steps.detail: Crack 3 eggs into a cold non-stick pan with 1 tsp butter. Stir together off heat.

steps.label: Stir over medium-low
steps.detail: Turn on to medium-low. Stir constantly with a silicone spatula, scraping the bottom and folding curds, 2-3 min. Pull off heat while still glossy and slightly wet so carryover finishes it.

steps.label: Salt and serve
steps.detail: Salt at the very end (salting early makes eggs weep) and serve immediately.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Dice onion and carrots, mince garlic, measure tomato paste, Worcestershire, thyme, flour, broth and peas/corn.

steps.label: Preheat oven to 400F
steps.detail: Heat the oven to 400F so it's ready when the pie is assembled.

steps.label: Boil and mash potatoes
steps.detail: Boil the potatoes in salted water 15 min until fork-tender. Drain. Mash with butter, milk, salt.

steps.label: Brown the beef
steps.detail: In a deep skillet brown the beef over medium-high 6-8 min. Drain off excess fat.

steps.label: Soften onion and carrot
steps.detail: Add onion and carrot. Cook 6 min until soft.

steps.label: Add garlic, paste & thyme
steps.detail: Add garlic, tomato paste, thyme, salt, pepper. Stir 1 min. Sprinkle flour over and stir 1 min more.

steps.label: Simmer filling with broth
steps.detail: Pour in broth + Worcestershire. Simmer 5 min until thick. Stir in frozen peas and corn, then take off heat.

steps.label: Top with mash & fork lines
steps.detail: Transfer filling to an 8x12 dish (or keep in an oven-safe skillet). Spread mashed potato over the top, drag a fork in lines, sprinkle with cheese if using.

steps.label: Bake until golden
steps.detail: Bake at 400F for 25-30 min until the top is golden and the filling bubbles at the edges.

steps.label: Rest then serve
steps.detail: Rest 10 min before serving.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Finely dice onion, mince garlic, grate parmesan, measure rice, wine and butter.

steps.label: Keep broth warm
steps.detail: Keep 5 cups broth warm in a small pot on a back burner; cold broth stops the cooking and ruins texture.

steps.label: Soften the onion
steps.detail: Heat oil + 2 tbsp butter in a wide pot over medium. Add onion + a pinch of salt. Cook 5 min until soft, not browned.

steps.label: Toast the rice
steps.detail: Add rice. Stir 2 min to toast - grains should look slightly translucent at the edges.

steps.label: Deglaze with wine
steps.detail: Add wine. Stir until fully absorbed.

steps.label: The 20-minute stir
steps.detail: Add warm broth a cup at a time, stirring until almost absorbed before the next ladle, until rice is al dente. Usually 18-22 min.

steps.label: Mantecatura finish
steps.detail: Off heat, stir in remaining 2 tbsp butter + the parmesan. Cover 2 min so it turns silky.

steps.label: Season and serve
steps.detail: Taste; add salt, pepper, lemon zest and fresh herbs. Serve immediately - risotto waits for no one.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather the ribeye, kosher salt, pepper, neutral oil, butter, smashed garlic and thyme/rosemary.

steps.label: Dry-brine overnight
steps.detail: The night before, salt the steak generously on all sides and rest uncovered on a rack in the fridge overnight to season deeply and dry the surface.

steps.label: Bring to room temp
steps.detail: 45 min before cooking, take the steak out of the fridge so it cooks evenly. Pat completely dry; if you skipped the dry-brine, salt heavily now.

steps.label: Preheat cast iron
steps.detail: Heat a cast iron skillet over high for 5 full minutes until it smokes when you wave a hand over it. Open a window and turn on the exhaust fan. Add oil and wait 30 sec until it shimmers and smokes.

steps.label: Sear both sides & fat cap
steps.detail: Lay the steak in away from you. Don't touch it for 3 min, then flip for 2 more min. Use tongs to sear the fat cap 30 sec.

steps.label: Butter-baste to temp
steps.detail: Reduce heat to medium. Add butter, garlic and herbs. Tilt the pan and spoon foaming butter over the steak for 60-90 sec. Pull at 125F for medium-rare or 135F for medium.

steps.label: Rest the steak
steps.detail: Transfer to a cutting board and rest 7-10 minutes. Non-negotiable.

steps.label: Slice and serve
steps.detail: Slice against the grain, sprinkle with flaky salt and pour the pan butter over the slices.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Dice onion, mince garlic, prep optional veg, measure turmeric, nutritional yeast, salt and kala namak.

steps.label: Crumble the tofu
steps.detail: Crumble the drained tofu with your hands or a fork into a bowl, aiming for scrambled-egg-sized curds.

steps.label: Cook onion & hard veg
steps.detail: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high. Add onion, cook 4 min. Add garlic and any harder vegetables (mushrooms), cook 3 min.

steps.label: Brown the tofu
steps.detail: Add the crumbled tofu. Cook 5 min, stirring, letting some bits brown.

steps.label: Add spices & soft veg
steps.detail: Add turmeric, nutritional yeast, salt, pepper and kala namak; stir to coat until everything turns golden. Add soft additions like spinach and tomato in the last minute.

steps.label: Taste and serve
steps.detail: Taste, adjust salt and serve.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Slice the onions thin, rinse lentils and rice, measure cumin, cinnamon, allspice and oil.

steps.label: Simmer the lentils
steps.detail: Cover rinsed lentils with water by 2 inches and simmer 20 min until almost tender (still a little firm). Drain, reserving the cooking liquid.

steps.label: Caramelize the onions
steps.detail: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Add the sliced onions and a big pinch of salt. Cook 25-30 min, stirring often, until deep golden and some are crispy. Pull out a handful of the crispiest to garnish.

steps.label: Add spices, lentils & rice
steps.detail: To the onions add cumin, cinnamon and allspice; stir 1 min. Add the drained lentils, the rice, and 2 cups of liquid (lentil broth + water). Season with salt and pepper.

steps.label: Cover and cook the rice
steps.detail: Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to the lowest heat. Cook 15 min.

steps.label: Rest and fluff
steps.detail: Off heat, still covered, rest 10 min. Fluff with a fork.

steps.label: Garnish and serve
steps.detail: Serve topped with the reserved crispy onions, a dollop of yogurt, parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Pat boar dry and season; finely dice onion, carrots and celery; mince garlic; measure tomato paste, wine, crushed tomatoes and broth.

steps.label: Brown the boar
steps.detail: Brown the seasoned boar in olive oil in a Dutch oven, in batches, until deeply crusted. Remove.

steps.label: Cook the soffritto
steps.detail: Add the soffritto (onion, carrot, celery). Cook 8-10 min until soft and lightly golden.

steps.label: Add garlic, paste & herbs
steps.detail: Add garlic, tomato paste, rosemary and juniper. Stir 2 min.

steps.label: Deglaze with red wine
steps.detail: Pour in the wine, scrape the bottom, and simmer 3 min to cook off the harsh alcohol.

steps.label: Braise low and slow
steps.detail: Return the boar. Add crushed tomatoes, broth and bay leaves. Bring to a simmer, then cover and braise at 300F (or lowest stovetop simmer) for 2.5-3 hours until falling-apart tender.

steps.label: Shred and thicken
steps.detail: Remove the boar, shred with two forks and return it to the sauce (skip if using ground boar). Simmer uncovered 15 min to thicken. Season.

steps.label: Cook the pappardelle
steps.detail: Cook the pappardelle in salted water and reserve some pasta water.

steps.label: Toss pasta with ragu
steps.detail: Toss the pasta with the ragu, loosening with pasta water. Serve with lots of parmesan.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Measure oats, liquid, salt and gather toppings.

steps.label: Combine oats and liquid
steps.detail: ½ cup oats + 1 cup water or milk + pinch of salt in a small pot.

steps.label: Simmer until thick
steps.detail: Bring to a boil, reduce to medium-low, stir occasionally for 5 min until thick. Add a splash more liquid if it tightens too much.

steps.label: Stir in toppings
steps.detail: Off heat, stir in your toppings and serve.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Smash garlic, measure oil and crushed red pepper, set out lemon and salt.

steps.label: Wash and dry greens
steps.detail: Wash the greens well (gritty greens ruin the dish). Spin or pat dry.

steps.label: Strip and ribbon greens
steps.detail: For tough greens (kale, chard, collards): strip leaves off stems, slice into ribbons. For tender greens (spinach, bok choy): leave whole or rough chop.

steps.label: Bloom garlic in oil
steps.detail: Heat a large skillet over medium-high with 2 tbsp olive oil. Add 3 smashed garlic cloves and a pinch of crushed red pepper for 30 seconds — don't let garlic brown.

steps.label: Saute the greens
steps.detail: Add the greens by the handful, tongs work best, tossing as they wilt. Cook until just tender: 1 min for spinach, 3-4 min for kale/chard/collards.

steps.label: Dress and serve
steps.detail: Off heat. Squeeze of lemon, pinch of salt, more olive oil. Done.

steps.label: Prep aromatics & chicken
steps.detail: Cut chicken thighs into 1-inch pieces. Dice onion, mince garlic, grate ginger. Measure out the dry spices and tomato paste.

steps.label: Sear the chicken
steps.detail: Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high. Salt and pepper the chicken. Sear in batches until browned on both sides (don't cook through), about 5 min. Remove to a plate.

steps.label: Build the curry base
steps.detail: Add onion + pinch of salt, cook 6 min. Add garlic and ginger, 1 min. Add tomato paste and all dry spices, stir 2 min until darkened. Add diced tomatoes with juice, scrape up fond, simmer 5 min until broken down.

steps.label: Simmer chicken in sauce
steps.detail: Stir in coconut milk (or tempered yogurt) and bring to a simmer. Return chicken and any juices. Reduce heat to low and simmer 15 min until chicken is cooked through and sauce thickens.

steps.label: Cook the rice
steps.detail: Start rice in a separate pot during the simmer: rinse, add water, bring to a boil, cover and cook on low until tender. Or warm naan instead.

steps.label: Chop cilantro, juice lemon
steps.detail: While the curry simmers, chop the cilantro and juice the lemon so they're ready to finish the dish.

steps.label: Finish & serve
steps.detail: Off heat, stir lemon juice into the curry and top with cilantro. Serve over the rice or with naan.

steps.label: Flake fish; chop scallions and dill
steps.detail: Drain canned salmon, pick out any large bones, flake into a bowl. Finely chop scallions, chop dill, zest and juice the lemon.

steps.label: Mix the fish cake batter
steps.detail: Add mashed potatoes, egg, mayo, mustard, scallions, dill, lemon zest + juice, salt, pepper, and 1/2 cup breadcrumbs. Mix gently with a fork until combined; adjust salt to taste.

steps.label: Form 6 patties
steps.detail: Form the mixture into 6 patties, about 1/2 inch thick.

steps.label: Chill patties to firm up
steps.detail: Refrigerate the patties 20 min so they hold together better while frying.

steps.label: Coat patties in breadcrumbs
steps.detail: Spread remaining breadcrumbs on a plate. Press each chilled patty into the crumbs on both sides to coat.

steps.label: Fry until golden, then drain
steps.detail: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium. Add patties without crowding (cook in batches if needed). Cook 4 min per side until deep golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Set out cottage cheese, cherry tomatoes, olive oil, salt, pepper and any herbs.

steps.label: Halve the tomatoes
steps.detail: Halve cherry tomatoes and season lightly with salt.

steps.label: Build the bowl
steps.detail: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl, top with the seasoned tomatoes, drizzle olive oil, and crack black pepper over.

steps.label: Rinse rice, slice ginger, combine in pot
steps.detail: Rinse the rice. Slice the ginger. Combine rice, water or broth, ginger, and salt in a large pot.

steps.label: Simmer into thick creamy porridge
steps.detail: Bring to a boil, then reduce to a low simmer. Cook 50-60 min, stirring occasionally (especially near the end so it doesn't stick), until the rice breaks down into a thick, creamy porridge. Add water if too thick.

steps.label: Prep congee toppings
steps.detail: While the congee simmers, prepare toppings: slice scallions, julienne extra ginger, fry shallots or eggs, set out soy sauce, sesame oil, chili crisp, and any protein.

steps.label: Adjust salt and serve with toppings
steps.detail: The texture should be like loose oatmeal — pourable but substantial. Taste and adjust salt. Ladle into bowls and add the prepared toppings.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Slice onion and apples, measure cider, broth, vinegar, Dijon and maple, and gather butter and oil.

steps.label: Season and temper chops
steps.detail: Take the chops out 30 min early. Pat dry. Season with salt, pepper, thyme.

steps.label: Sear the chops
steps.detail: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear the chops 3-4 min per side until deeply browned. Pull at 145°F. Rest on a plate.

steps.label: Cook onion and apples
steps.detail: In the same pan, add 1 tbsp butter. Add the onion and apple slices. Cook 6-8 min until softened and golden.

steps.label: Build the pan sauce
steps.detail: Pour in the cider, broth, vinegar, Dijon, maple. Scrape up the browned bits. Simmer 3-4 min until slightly thickened. Off heat, swirl in the last tbsp of butter.

steps.label: Return chops and serve
steps.detail: Return the chops and any resting juices to the pan to coat. Serve with the apples and sauce spooned over.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Core and thinly slice the cabbage (~6 cups), smash and chop garlic, grate ginger, measure soy sauce, sesame oil and chili.

steps.label: Heat the pan
steps.detail: Heat the largest pan you have over high heat. Add the oil — it should shimmer immediately.

steps.label: Bloom garlic & ginger
steps.detail: Add garlic and ginger. Stir 15 seconds — don't let it burn.

steps.label: Stir-fry the cabbage
steps.detail: Dump in the cabbage — it'll seem like too much, it isn't. Toss with tongs every 30 seconds until edges char and volume halves.

steps.label: Season off heat
steps.detail: Off heat. Add soy sauce, sesame oil and chili. Toss once more, then serve.

steps.label: Prep onion, garlic & cabbage
steps.detail: Dice the onion, mince the garlic, and shred half a head of green cabbage (~6 cups). Measure the rice, tomato paste, paprika, and oregano.

steps.label: Brown the beef
steps.detail: Brown the ground beef in a deep skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high, about 6 min. Drain off excess fat.

steps.label: Cook aromatics & wilt cabbage
steps.detail: Add onion, cook 5 min, then garlic, tomato paste, paprika and oregano, 1 min. Add cabbage and cook 4 min, tossing, until it halves in volume.

steps.label: Simmer rice until tender
steps.detail: Add rice, diced tomatoes with juice, broth, salt and pepper. Stir, bring to a boil, then reduce to a low simmer and cover. Cook 18-20 min until rice is tender and liquid is mostly absorbed.

steps.label: Chop fresh dill
steps.detail: While the rice simmers, chop the fresh dill (if using) so it's ready to scatter over the finished skillet.

steps.label: Rest & serve
steps.detail: Off heat 5 min, covered. Top with the chopped dill and serve.

steps.label: Soak the rice noodles
steps.detail: Soak rice noodles in room-temp water 30 min until pliable but still firm (NOT hot water — they'll go to mush). Drain.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Beat eggs, slice scallions and protein, mince garlic, crush peanuts, mix the sauce. Stir-frying happens fast — have everything within reach.

steps.label: Heat the wok
steps.detail: Heat a wok or large nonstick skillet over high heat. Add 2 tbsp oil.

steps.label: Stir-fry the protein
steps.detail: Add protein. Stir-fry 2–3 min until cooked. Push to one side of the pan.

steps.label: Scramble the eggs
steps.detail: Add 1 tbsp oil to the empty side. Pour in eggs, let set 30 sec, then scramble briefly. Push to the side with the protein.

steps.label: Toss noodles & sauce
steps.detail: Add garlic to center of pan, 15 sec. Add drained noodles, pour sauce over, toss vigorously with tongs 2 min until glossy.

steps.label: Add sprouts & scallions
steps.detail: Add bean sprouts and scallions. Toss 30 sec.

steps.label: Plate & garnish
steps.detail: Off heat. Plate. Top with crushed peanuts, cilantro and lime wedges.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Grate zucchini on the large holes, mince garlic, chop herbs, slice scallion, zest lemon, measure flour and cheese.

steps.label: Salt & drain zucchini
steps.detail: Toss the grated zucchini with 1 tsp salt in a colander. Let it drain in the sink 15 min — salt draws out the water.

steps.label: Squeeze zucchini dry
steps.detail: Squeeze handfuls in your fists over the sink, then wrap in a clean towel and twist until no more water comes out. The drier the zucchini, the crispier the fritter.

steps.label: Mix the batter
steps.detail: In a bowl combine dried zucchini, eggs, flour, cheese, garlic, herbs, scallion, pepper and lemon zest. Taste and adjust salt.

steps.label: Heat the oil
steps.detail: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high.

steps.label: Fry the fritters
steps.detail: Scoop ¼ cup portions into the pan, flatten with a spatula, don't crowd. Fry 3 min per side until deeply golden and cooked through.

steps.label: Drain & salt
steps.detail: Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with flaky salt while hot.

steps.label: Prep onion, pepper & garlic
steps.detail: Dice the onion and bell pepper, mince the garlic. Drain the white beans and measure the green chilies and all the spices.

steps.label: Brown the turkey
steps.detail: Heat oil in a Dutch oven. Brown the ground turkey over medium-high, 8 min, breaking it up. Salt as it cooks.

steps.label: Cook vegetables & spices
steps.detail: Add onion and pepper, cook 6 min. Add garlic, green chilies and all spices, stir 2 min. Add white beans and broth, bring to a simmer.

steps.label: Simmer the chili
steps.detail: Cook 25 min, uncovered, stirring occasionally. For body, mash some beans against the side of the pot or puree 1 cup and return it.

steps.label: Cook rice (optional side)
steps.detail: Start rice in a separate pot during the simmer if serving the chili over rice: rinse, add water, boil, cover and cook on low until tender.

steps.label: Chop cilantro, cut lime
steps.detail: While the chili simmers, chop the cilantro and cut the lime into wedges. Have Greek yogurt ready if making a creamy version.

steps.label: Finish & serve
steps.detail: Off heat, stir in lime juice (or swirl in Greek yogurt). Top with cilantro and serve, over the rice if using.

steps.label: Peel & slice potatoes and onion
steps.detail: Peel 1.5 lbs Yukon Gold potatoes and slice thin (1/8 inch). Slice 1 onion thin.

steps.label: Confit potatoes & onion in oil
steps.detail: Heat 3/4 cup olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium. Add potatoes and onion with a big pinch of salt. Cook gently 20-25 min, stirring occasionally — poach soft in oil, do not brown.

steps.label: Beat the eggs
steps.detail: Beat 6 eggs in a large bowl with 1 tsp salt. Set aside. Done while the potatoes confit.

steps.label: Drain potatoes & soak in egg
steps.detail: Drain potatoes in a colander over a bowl (save the oil). Add the warm potatoes and onion to the beaten eggs. Let sit 10 min so the potatoes soak up the egg.

steps.label: Cook the first side
steps.detail: Heat 2 tbsp reserved oil in the skillet over medium. Pour in the egg-potato mixture and spread evenly. Cook 5-6 min until bottom and edges are set but top is still loose.

steps.label: Flip & cook second side
steps.detail: Place a large plate over the skillet and flip the tortilla onto it, then slide back into the skillet uncooked side down. Cook 3-4 min — keep the center slightly custardy (jugosa).

steps.label: Rest & cut into wedges
steps.detail: Slide onto a plate. Rest 5 min, then cut into wedges.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Mince shallot, crush peppercorns, measure brandy, broth, cream, Dijon and butter.

steps.label: Temper & season loin
steps.detail: Take the kangaroo out 30 min early. Pat very dry. Season with salt and coarsely cracked pepper.

steps.label: Sear the loin
steps.detail: Heat oil in a pan over high until shimmering. Sear the loin 2–3 min per side maximum, adding 1 tbsp butter near the end to baste.

steps.label: Rest the kangaroo
steps.detail: Pull at 125°F (rare to medium-rare) — never cook kangaroo past medium-rare. Remove and rest 5–10 min so the lean fibers reabsorb juices.

steps.label: Make the pepper sauce
steps.detail: In the same pan add shallot and crushed peppercorns, 1 min. Add brandy (may flame), scrape the bottom. Add broth, reduce by half. Stir in cream and Dijon, simmer 2 min, swirl in the last butter.

steps.label: Slice & plate
steps.detail: Slice the rested kangaroo thin against the grain. Spoon the pepper sauce over.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Read recipe through, gather and measure ingredients, mix the spice rub, clear the counter.

steps.label: Rub & dry-brine
steps.detail: Rub the shoulder all over and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight to dry-brine and dry the surface.

steps.label: Preheat oven to 300F
steps.detail: Preheat the oven to 300F and set the pork fat-side up in a Dutch oven or roasting pan with a lid.

steps.label: Add liquid & cover
steps.detail: Pour 1 cup of water or broth around (not over) the meat, then cover the pan.

steps.label: Roast covered
steps.detail: Roast at 300F for 3.5-4 hours until a fork twists easily in the thickest part; internal temp ~200F.

steps.label: Crank heat & crisp fat cap
steps.detail: Uncover, raise oven to 425F, and roast 15-20 more min to crisp the fat cap.

steps.label: Rest the pork
steps.detail: Rest 30 min so the juices redistribute.

steps.label: Pull & skim juices
steps.detail: Pull the pork apart with two forks, then reserve and skim the pan juices.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather and measure ingredients, dice red onion, chop dill pickles, slice cheddar.

steps.label: Drain the tuna
steps.detail: Drain 2 cans of tuna very well, pressing with a fork to remove liquid.

steps.label: Mix the tuna salad
steps.detail: Mix tuna with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon, diced red onion, chopped pickles, juice of half a lemon, black pepper. Taste and adjust salt.

steps.label: Build the sandwich
steps.detail: Butter the outside of both bread slices. Inside: cheddar, mound of tuna salad, more cheddar; close it up.

steps.label: Grill low and slow
steps.detail: Heat a non-stick or cast iron pan over medium-LOW. Add sandwich, press, 3-4 min per side until deep golden and cheese is fully melted.

steps.label: Rest & cut
steps.detail: Rest 1 min before cutting so the cheese doesn't run out.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather and measure ingredients, slice and prep vegetables, set out sesame oil and seeds; warm 2 cups cooked white rice.

steps.label: Saute the vegetables
steps.detail: Quickly saute the prepped vegetables in batches and season; set aside in sections.

steps.label: Fry crispy eggs
steps.detail: Fry 2 eggs with crispy bottoms and runny yolks.

steps.label: Build the bowl
steps.detail: Put warm rice in a bowl and arrange the sauteed vegetables on top in sections.

steps.label: Top & finish
steps.detail: Set the fried eggs on top, drizzle 1 tbsp sesame oil and sprinkle 2 tsp sesame seeds; serve.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Strip remaining meat off the carcass, gather aromatics: onion, carrots, celery, garlic, bay leaf, peppercorns.

steps.label: Load the pressure cooker
steps.detail: Add carcass, 8 cups water, halved onion (skin on), carrots, celery, smashed garlic, bay leaf and peppercorns to the Instant Pot.

steps.label: Pressure cook stock
steps.detail: Cook 45 min high pressure, then let it natural-release.

steps.label: Strain the stock
steps.detail: Strain out the solids into a clean container.

steps.label: Cool & skim
steps.detail: Cool the stock, then skim the fat from the surface.

steps.label: Portion & store
steps.detail: Use within 4 days or freeze in 2-cup portions.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Cube 150g sushi-grade salmon, slice avocado, dice cucumber, shred carrot, prep edamame, scallion and garnishes.

steps.label: Whisk the dressing
steps.detail: Whisk the dressing ingredients together in a bowl.

steps.label: Marinate the salmon
steps.detail: Add cubed salmon to the dressing, gently toss, and let marinate 5-10 min while you prep the rest.

steps.label: Rice into bowl
steps.detail: Put 1 cup cooked sushi or white rice (warm or room temp) into a serving bowl.

steps.label: Arrange the bowl
steps.detail: Arrange marinated salmon, avocado, cucumber, carrot and edamame on top of the rice in sections; drizzle remaining dressing.

steps.label: Garnish & serve
steps.detail: Garnish with scallion, sesame seeds and nori strips; optional spicy mayo (1 tbsp mayo + 1 tsp sriracha).

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Pat fish dry and cut into strips, prep cabbage and onion, measure flour and spices, set out frying oil.

steps.label: Toss the slaw
steps.detail: Toss cabbage, onion, lime juice, oil, salt and cilantro; set aside to soften as it sits.

steps.label: Whisk the crema
steps.detail: Whisk yogurt, lime, garlic and salt together; set aside.

steps.label: Dredge the fish
steps.detail: Mix flour with the spices on a plate, then dredge the dry fish strips in the seasoned flour.

steps.label: Fry the fish
steps.detail: Heat 1/4 inch oil over medium-high, fry fish 2-3 min per side until golden, crispy and flaking; drain on paper towels.

steps.label: Warm the tortillas
steps.detail: Warm tortillas in a dry skillet, 30 sec per side.

steps.label: Assemble the tacos
steps.detail: Build each: tortilla + slaw + fish + crema drizzle + cilantro + lime squeeze + hot sauce.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather ingredients, pat the 8 quail very dry, set up a rack over a foil-lined sheet pan.

steps.label: Preheat oven to 425F
steps.detail: Preheat the oven to 425F.

steps.label: Season the quail
