steps.detail: Season the dried quail inside and out with salt and pepper.

steps.label: Whisk & brush glaze
steps.detail: Whisk the glaze ingredients together and brush the quail all over, reserving half the glaze.

steps.label: Set quail on rack
steps.detail: Place quail breast-side up on the rack over the foil-lined sheet pan; tuck the wing tips under.

steps.label: Roast the quail
steps.detail: Roast 15-18 min at 425F, brushing with more glaze halfway, until skin is deep golden and lacquered and thigh reads 165F.

steps.label: Optional broil
steps.detail: Broil 1-2 min for extra char on the glaze; watch closely as the honey burns fast.

steps.label: Rest & finish
steps.detail: Rest 5 min, then brush with any remaining glaze.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather the can, a plate, and any garnishes (lemon, herbs, crackers, bread).

steps.label: Open & plate the fish
steps.detail: Open the can of sardines or mackerel in olive oil and turn the fish out onto a plate, draping over toast or crackers.

steps.label: Dress & serve
steps.detail: Drizzle the tin oil over the fish, add a squeeze of lemon, flaky salt, and herbs. Serve as reference-style pantry protein.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Read through, gather sweet potatoes, fork, and a parchment-lined sheet pan.

steps.label: Preheat oven to 425F
steps.detail: Preheat the oven to 425F while you scrub and prep the potatoes.

steps.label: Scrub & stab potatoes
steps.detail: Scrub 4 medium sweet potatoes and pat dry. Stab each 4-5 times with a fork and set on the parchment-lined sheet pan.

steps.label: Roast until caramelized
steps.detail: Roast 45-55 min until very soft with caramelized juices oozing onto the parchment. The longer they roast, the sweeter they get.

steps.label: Crack open & serve
steps.detail: Squeeze the ends to crack each potato open and add toppings.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Drain chickpeas (reserve aquafaba), measure tahini, lemon juice, grate garlic, gather ice cubes, cumin, salt, olive oil.

steps.label: Whip tahini base
steps.detail: In a food processor combine tahini, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and ice cubes. Process 1 min until pale and fluffy. The ice + tahini emulsion creates the silky texture.

steps.label: Blend in chickpeas
steps.detail: Add chickpeas and cumin. Process 2 min, scraping the sides, until completely smooth. Add 2-3 tbsp aquafaba until soft and scoopable.

steps.label: Taste & adjust
steps.detail: Taste and add more lemon, salt, or tahini until balanced.

steps.label: Scoop & garnish
steps.detail: Scoop into a bowl, make a well with the back of a spoon, drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle paprika and parsley.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Gather noodles, seasoning packet, aromatics (garlic, ginger), veg, protein, miso, and finishing oils.

steps.label: Soft-boil an egg
steps.detail: Soft-boil an egg with a 6:30 timer, then peel and halve for the topping.

steps.label: Boil water & noodles
steps.detail: Bring 2 cups water to a boil and add the noodles. Use only HALF the seasoning packet — the full packet is excessive.

steps.label: Add aromatics & veg
steps.detail: Add garlic and ginger, cook 2 min, then add vegetables and cook 1 more min.

steps.label: Off heat, add miso
steps.detail: Take off the heat and stir in miso paste if using — boiling kills the live cultures.

steps.label: Bowl & top
steps.detail: Pour into a bowl, top with the halved egg, protein, and aromatics, then finish with oils and condiments.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Wedge tomatoes, half-moon cucumber, thin-slice onion and pepper, gather olives, feta slab, oil, vinegar, oregano.

steps.label: Combine the vegetables
steps.detail: Combine tomatoes, cucumber, onion, pepper, and olives in a bowl.

steps.label: Dress & toss
steps.detail: Drizzle with olive oil and red wine vinegar, season with salt and pepper, toss gently.

steps.label: Plate with feta slab
steps.detail: Transfer to a serving plate, set the feta slab on top, drizzle the feta with more oil and a generous sprinkle of oregano.

steps.label: Rest 10 min
steps.detail: Let it sit 10 min before serving — salt draws juices from the tomatoes that mix with the oil into a dressing.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Finely dice onion, carrot, celery; mince garlic; measure lentils, tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, broth, wine, soy sauce, herbs.

steps.label: Cook the soffritto
steps.detail: Heat oil in a large pot or Dutch oven. Add onion, carrot, celery and cook 8-10 min until soft and starting to brown. Don't rush this — it's the flavor base.

steps.label: Bloom paste & herbs
steps.detail: Add garlic, tomato paste, dried herbs, red pepper. Stir 2 min until the tomato paste darkens.

steps.label: Deglaze with wine
steps.detail: Pour in the wine if using, scrape the bottom, simmer 2 min.

steps.label: Simmer the sauce
steps.detail: Add lentils, crushed tomatoes, broth, soy sauce. Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered 30-35 min, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender and sauce is thick. Add water if too dry. Season generously.

steps.label: Cook the pasta
steps.detail: Cook the pasta and reserve some pasta water.

steps.label: Toss pasta with sauce
steps.detail: Toss the pasta with the sauce, adding pasta water to loosen.

steps.label: Serve with parmesan
steps.detail: Plate and serve with parmesan.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Pat duck very dry, gather salt, pepper, a cold dry pan, jar for rendered fat, and sauce ingredients.

steps.label: Score & season skin
steps.detail: Score the skin in a crosshatch — through the fat but not into the meat. Season both sides with salt and pepper.

steps.label: Cold-pan render skin
steps.detail: Place breasts skin-side down in a COLD dry pan, then turn heat to medium. Cook 8-12 min until skin is deep golden and crackly-crisp, pouring off rendered fat into a jar 2-3 times.

steps.label: Flip & finish to temp
steps.detail: Flip and cook 3-4 min on the meat side. Pull at 130-135F for medium-rare — served pink like a steak.

steps.label: Rest skin-side up
steps.detail: Rest 5-10 min skin-side up so the skin stays crisp.

steps.label: Make the pan sauce
steps.detail: Pour off all but 1 tsp fat. Add juice/cherries, broth, honey, vinegar and simmer to reduce by half, then swirl in butter.

steps.label: Slice & plate
steps.detail: Slice thin against the grain, fan out, and spoon sauce around the meat — not over the skin, to keep it crisp.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Dice the onion, mince the garlic, measure tomato paste and seasoning blend. Set out 5 containers.

steps.label: Brown the beef
steps.detail: Heat a large skillet over medium-high (no oil). Add 1 kg lean ground beef, break it up and spread it. Let it sit undisturbed 4-5 min for a deep brown crust.

steps.label: Finish browning & drain
steps.detail: Stir and break apart. Cook another 4-5 min until no pink remains and liquid has evaporated. Drain off excess fat, keeping about 1 tbsp.

steps.label: Cook onion & garlic
steps.detail: Add the diced onion, minced garlic, salt and pepper. Cook 5 min until the onion softens.

steps.label: Add paste & seasoning
steps.detail: Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste and 1 tbsp seasoning blend. Cook 2 min.

steps.label: Cool & portion
steps.detail: Cool, then portion into 5 containers, about 1 cup each.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Measure oats, milk, yogurt, chia, sweetener, salt, and your mix-ins.

steps.label: Layer the jar
steps.detail: Layer all ingredients into a half-pint mason jar.

steps.label: Seal & shake
steps.detail: Seal the jar and shake to combine.

steps.label: Refrigerate overnight
steps.detail: Refrigerate at least 4 hours, ideally overnight.

steps.label: Eat from the jar
steps.detail: Eat cold with a spoon, or microwave 60 sec with a splash more milk if you prefer it warm.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Set out the baguette, mayo/sriracha, pâté, protein, pickled veg, cucumber, jalapeño, cilantro, and Maggi.

steps.label: Prep the baguette
steps.detail: Split a small baguette lengthwise. Pull out some soft interior to make room.

steps.label: Slice fresh veg
steps.detail: Cut thin cucumber spears and slice fresh jalapeño rings; drain the pickled vegetables.

steps.label: Schmear the bread
steps.detail: Spread mayo (optionally mixed with sriracha) on the bottom half; a thin layer of pâté on the top half.

steps.label: Build & cut
steps.detail: Layer the protein, drained pickles, cucumber, jalapeño, cilantro, and a drizzle of Maggi. Close, press gently, cut in half.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Measure vinegar, water, sugar, and salt; set out a mason jar.

steps.label: Slice the vegetable
steps.detail: Slice the red onion (or any vegetable) as thin as you can — thinner pickles faster. Pack into the jar.

steps.label: Mix the brine
steps.detail: In a measuring cup, combine ½ cup hot water, ½ cup vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt. Stir until dissolved.

steps.label: Pour & submerge
steps.detail: Pour the brine over the vegetables, making sure they are submerged.

steps.label: Pickle at room temp
steps.detail: Wait 60 min at room temp (or 30 if the slices are razor-thin).

steps.label: Refrigerate
steps.detail: Refrigerate and use as a condiment.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Dice the onion and bell pepper, mince the garlic, measure ketchup, tomato paste, brown sugar, Worcestershire, mustard, and spices. Toast the buns.

steps.label: Brown the beef
steps.detail: Brown 1.5 lbs lean ground beef in a skillet over medium-high, 6 min, breaking it up. Drain excess fat.

steps.label: Cook onion & pepper
steps.detail: Add the diced onion and bell pepper. Cook 5 min until soft.

steps.label: Add garlic & tomato paste
steps.detail: Add the garlic and tomato paste. Stir 1 min.

steps.label: Add the sauce
steps.detail: Add ketchup, brown sugar, Worcestershire, mustard, paprika, chili powder, and water. Stir.

steps.label: Simmer to thicken
steps.detail: Simmer 8-10 min until thickened to a sloppy, spoonable consistency.

steps.label: Taste & serve
steps.detail: Taste and adjust salt, sugar, or vinegar. Spoon generously onto toasted buns.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Pat shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper, mince garlic, zest and juice the lemon, chop parsley, measure butter, oil, wine, and red pepper flakes.

steps.label: Boil the pasta
steps.detail: Cook the pasta in well-salted water 1 min less than the package says. Reserve 1 cup pasta water, then drain.

steps.label: Sear the shrimp
steps.detail: Heat 2 tbsp oil + 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high. Add shrimp in a single layer, cook 1-2 min per side until just pink and opaque. Remove to a plate.

steps.label: Bloom garlic & chili
steps.detail: In the same skillet add remaining oil + butter, garlic, and red pepper flakes. Cook 1 min until fragrant — don't brown the garlic.

steps.label: Deglaze & reduce
steps.detail: Pour in the wine and lemon juice. Scrape the bottom and simmer 2 min to reduce slightly.

steps.label: Toss the pasta
steps.detail: Add the drained pasta, lemon zest, and ½ cup pasta water. Toss over medium heat 1-2 min until the sauce emulsifies and clings.

steps.label: Return shrimp & serve
steps.detail: Return the shrimp, add parsley, toss to combine, adding more pasta water if dry. Off heat, taste and adjust salt. Serve with parmesan and more lemon.

steps.label: Mise en place
steps.detail: Pat rabbit pieces dry and season with salt and pepper; dice bacon and onion, mince garlic, measure wine, broth, both mustards, cream, and thyme.

steps.label: Dredge the rabbit
steps.detail: Dredge the seasoned rabbit pieces lightly in flour.

steps.label: Render the bacon
steps.detail: In a Dutch oven, render the diced bacon until crisp. Remove the bits, leave the fat, then add the oil + butter.

steps.label: Brown the rabbit
steps.detail: Brown the rabbit pieces on all sides, 8-10 min, working in batches. Remove to a plate.

steps.label: Cook onion & garlic
steps.detail: Add the onion and cook 5 min. Add the garlic and cook 1 min.

steps.label: Deglaze with wine
steps.detail: Pour in the wine, scrape up the browned bits, and simmer 3 min.

steps.label: Build the braise
steps.detail: Whisk in the broth and both mustards. Return the rabbit and bacon — liquid should come most of the way up the pieces. Add thyme.

steps.label: Cover & braise
steps.detail: Cover and braise gently (or at 325°F) for 45 min, until the rabbit is tender and pulling from the bone.

steps.label: Finish the sauce
steps.detail: Remove the rabbit. Stir the cream into the sauce and simmer 5 min to thicken. Taste and season. Return the rabbit to coat and finish with parsley.
